arguments.issue: Customer reports delivered garden hose arrived cracked. Customer needs replacement by next day for a project (time-sensitive).
arguments.customer_intent: Receive a replacement garden hose (send another one) or refund if replacement unavailable; needs it by tomorrow.
arguments.summary: Delivered 100ft Heavy-Duty Garden Hose (NS-1001) arrived cracked. Customer (Sarah Johnson) requests a replacement for a project scheduled tomorrow. AI cannot confirm inventory or guarantee expedited shipping.
arguments.policy_reason: Policy requires escalation when a customer requires delivery by a specific date and when expedited shipping may be needed. AI cannot verify inventory or promise expedited shipping, so human agent must confirm stock and shipping options.
arguments.recommended_action: Human agent should: 1) Verify inventory for product P-001; 2) Determine available shipping options and whether expedited shipping can meet customer's deadline; 3) If expedited shipping is possible, authorize and arrange it or offer alternatives; 4) If replacement is unavailable or expedited shipping cannot meet deadline, offer a full refund or alternative solution; 5) Contact customer (sarah@example.com) with options and next steps. Include request for photo of damage if needed.

arguments.message:
Hi Sarah — I'm sorry to hear your 100ft Heavy‑Duty Garden Hose arrived cracked. I know you need it for a project tomorrow and I understand how stressful that is. I’ve opened this with our support team so a human agent can confirm inventory and available shipping options.

To help us move quickly, could you reply with whether you’d prefer a replacement or a full refund? If possible, please attach a photo of the crack/damage — that will help speed the process. A human agent will review the case and contact you at this email with available options and next steps. I can’t promise expedited shipping from here, but the team will work to find the fastest solution.

Again, I’m sorry for the trouble — we’ll follow up shortly.
